The N.I.C.E. process keeps the user and the evidence in view from the first question to the next version. Use the matching worksheet beside the step where you need it.

![The N.I.C.E. design process grows from a clearly described situation through Needs, Inquiry, Create and Communicate, and Evaluate. The cycle repeats as evidence improves the design.](../../assets/nice-design-process/lighthouse-garden.png){fig-alt="A lighthouse garden illustration shows the N.I.C.E. design cycle repeating upward from a rock labelled Situation."}
